kill_fact: The record understates the share count, so both the event-win target and the floor are too high. The 10-Q for the quarter ended 30 September 2026 (filed 28 October 2026, Note 16) lists 100,962,751 pre-funded warrants convertible into 142,647,271 ordinary shares, not 101.0 million. The PIPE tranche PFW2 converts at 1.75 shares per warrant. The Q3 weighted share count of 451.0 million ordinary shares includes the warrant shares, and the reported loss of $0.14 per share ($64.5M / 451M) confirms the larger figure. With 314.4 million ordinary shares, that is about 91.4 million ADS before options and RSUs and about 95 million fully diluted. The record uses 83 to 88 million. On the record's own equity value of $2.0 to 2.1 billion after a $250 million launch raise (about 12 million new ADS), the approval case is worth about $19 per ADS, not $22. On the record's own $180 to 240 million wind-down value, the failure case is worth about $2.20, not $2.50. From $10.27 that leaves about +$8.7 of upside against about -$8.1 of downside, roughly 1.1 to 1. The catalyst is also soft. The 28 October 2026 release says only that filing acceptance and priority review are 'expected in Q4 2026'. No PDUFA date has been assigned, so the approval decision is around May 2027 at the earliest and around September 2027 on a standard clock, which is past the stated runway 'into the third quarter of 2027'. There is no contractual floor: the 10-Q carries going-concern substantial doubt, and about $100M of the refreshed $150M ATM remains. As a defined-risk event trade this has neither a dated binding trigger nor a backstop.
corrections: Pre-funded warrants convert into 142,647,271 ordinary shares (28.5M ADS), not 101.0M ordinary shares (20.2M ADS). 100,962,751 is the number of WARRANTS. PFW2 (55,579,360 warrants) converts at 1.75 shares each, into 97,263,880 shares (10-Q Note 16).
Fully diluted ADS are about 95M (314.4M ordinary + 142.6M PFW + 15.0M options + 10.0M RSU = about 482M ordinary / 5), not 83 to 88M. After the launch raise the count is about 107M, not 95 to 100M.
Cash per diluted ADS today is about $1.72 ($165.7M / ~96M), not about $2.00.

The event-win value is about $19 per ADS (record method, corrected denominator), not $22. The failure floor is about $2.20, not $2.50. The probability-weighted fair value moves from about $13.85 to about $12.0 (0.55 x 19 + 0.25 x 4.4 + 0.20 x 2.2).

A mild offset the bear text omits: the Q3 release states that the Pre-Approval Inspection target date in the BLA falls after Fareva's expected remediation completion date, and that Fareva responded to the FDA on time and files monthly updates. This does not remove the sole-source risk, but the mock-inspection gate (no critical findings, no repeat observations, all findings remediated by 1 Feb 2027, per Amendment No. 1 dated 30 Sep 2026) is confirmed in the 10-Q.

Catalyst confirmation: the BLA was submitted 29 Sep 2026 with Priority Review requested; as of 16 Nov 2026 no acceptance or priority-review announcement was found. The board's 'FDA approval decision 28 Nov 2026' is the wrong event, because only the day-60 filing and clock decision falls there.
